chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad and Fadalah, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the hide.
He said: Give it in charity, or make it into a musalla to be used in the house, and do not give it to the butchers.
And he said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade that its coverings, its hides, and its collars be given to the butchers, and he commanded that they be given in charity.

key_terms.الْإِهَابِ: the hide or skin of the sacrificed animal
key_terms.جِلَالُهَا: its coverings or cloths placed upon it
key_terms.مُصَلًّى: a prayer-place or prayer mat used for salat

ai.seo_question: What should be done with the hide of the sacrificial offering, and may it be given to the butcher?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the hide and related items of the sacrificial offering. It instructs that they should be given in charity or put to lawful use in the home, and specifically forbids giving them to butchers, citing the prohibition of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
